summary_en: Panasonic raised FY2027 year-end dividend forecast to 43 yen per share from 27 yen, bringing annual dividend to 70 yen, up 30 yen from prior year actual of 40 yen, reflecting revised earnings guidance and targeting 30% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase in Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Panasonic Holdings revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, with approval from the Board of Directors on October 30, 2026. The year-end dividend per share was raised to 43 yen from the previously announced 27 yen, increasing the annual dividend to 70 yen per share. This represents an increase of 30 yen compared to the prior fiscal year's actual dividend of 40 yen.

The company cited revised full-year consolidated earnings guidance as the basis for the increase. The dividend policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30% while maintaining stable and continuous distributions in line with consolidated performance. The 16-yen increase from the prior announcement reflects confidence in improved earnings prospects. The interim dividend for the second quarter remains unchanged at 27 yen per share.
